mapper.sql: select s.session_id, s.account_id, s.installation_id, s.status as session_status, s.created_at, s.revoked_at, a.status as account_status, a.latest_consent_status, a.created_at as account_created_at, a.deleted_at from account_sessions s join accounts a on a.account_id = s.account_id
mapper.insert: insert into sms_challenges ( challenge_id, phone_lookup_ref, phone_mask, verification_verifier, status, issued_at, expires_at, verified_at, failure_reason, verification_attempts ) values ( #{row.challengeId}, #{row.phoneLookupRef}, #{row.phoneMask}, #{row.verificationVerifier}, #{row.status}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.verifiedAt}, #{row.failureReason}, #{row.verificationAttempts} )
mapper.select: select challenge_id, phone_lookup_ref, phone_mask, verification_verifier, status, issued_at, expires_at, verified_at, failure_reason, verification_attempts from sms_challenges where challenge_id = #{challengeId}

select challenge_id, phone_lookup_ref, phone_mask, verification_verifier, status, issued_at, expires_at, verified_at, failure_reason, verification_attempts from sms_challenges where challenge_id = #{challengeId} for update
mapper.update: update sms_challenges set status = 'verified', verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, failure_reason = null where challenge_id = #{challengeId} and status = 'pending'

update sms_challenges set verification_attempts = verification_attempts + 1, status = case when verification_attempts + 1 >= 5 then 'expired' else status end, failure_reason = case when verification_attempts + 1 >= 5 then 'verification_attempt_limit' else 'verification_code_invalid' end where challenge_id = #{challengeId} and status = 'pending'
mapper.select: select account_id, phone_lookup_ref, phone_mask, status, latest_consent_status, created_at, deleted_at from accounts where phone_lookup_ref = #{phoneLookupRef} and status = 'active'
select account_id, phone_lookup_ref, phone_mask, status, latest_consent_status, created_at, deleted_at from accounts where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: insert into accounts ( account_id, phone_lookup_ref, phone_mask, status, latest_consent_status, created_at, deleted_at ) values ( #{row.accountId}, #{row.phoneLookupRef}, #{row.phoneMask}, #{row.status}, #{row.latestConsentStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.deletedAt} )

insert into account_sessions ( session_id, account_id, installation_id, status, created_at, revoked_at ) values ( #{row.sessionId}, #{row.accountId}, #{row.installationId}, #{row.sessionStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.revokedAt} )

insert into account_refresh_tokens ( refresh_token_id, account_id, session_id, status, issued_at, expires_at, updated_at, rotated_at, revoked_at, replacement_token_id ) values ( #{row.refreshTokenId}, #{row.accountId}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.status}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.updatedAt}, #{row.rotatedAt}, #{row.revokedAt}, #{row.replacementTokenId} )
mapper.select: select refresh_token_id, account_id, session_id, status, issued_at, expires_at, updated_at, rotated_at, revoked_at, replacement_token_id from account_refresh_tokens where refresh_token_id = #{refreshTokenId}

select refresh_token_id, account_id, session_id, status, issued_at, expires_at, updated_at, rotated_at, revoked_at, replacement_token_id from account_refresh_tokens where refresh_token_id = #{refreshTokenId} for update
mapper.update: update account_refresh_tokens set status = 'rotated', rotated_at = #{rotatedAt}, updated_at = #{rotatedAt}, replacement_token_id = #{replacementTokenId} where refresh_token_id = #{refreshTokenId} and status = 'active'
mapper.insert: insert into consent_audit_logs ( account_id, session_id, installation_id, action, result, reason, created_at ) values ( #{row.accountId}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.installationId}, #{row.action}, #{row.result}, #{row.reason}, #{row.createdAt} )
mapper.select: select account_id, session_id, installation_id, action, result, reason, created_at from consent_audit_logs where account_id = #{accountId} order by created_at asc, audit_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into interaction_events ( event_key, account_id, session_id, installation_id, local_event_id, space_id, activity_id, phrase_id, reaction_type, client_timestamp, received_at ) values ( #{event.eventKey}, #{accountId}, #{sessionId}, #{event.installationId}, #{event.localEventId}, #{event.spaceId}, #{event.activityId}, #{event.phraseId}, #{event.reactionType}, #{event.clientTimestamp}, #{receivedAt} ) on conflict (event_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select event_key, local_event_id, installation_id, space_id, activity_id, phrase_id, reaction_type, client_timestamp, received_at from interaction_events where account_id = #{accountId} and installation_id = #{installationId} order by client_timestamp asc, event_key asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update accounts set status = 'deleted', phone_lookup_ref = #{tombstonePhone}, phone_mask = '账号已删除', latest_consent_status = 'deleted', deleted_at = #{deletedAt} where account_id = #{accountId}
